card.name: Ends of cholera and similar medical words
card.fires_on: The final piece of split medical words such as chol-era, anticoag-ulation and metabisulf-ite. It also fires on 'before' after an hour count in dose timing.

modes.label: Word endings
modes.description: The last piece of a longer medical term split into parts, most often 'era' in cholera.

modes.label: Before after hours
modes.description: The word 'before' right after a number of hours in dose timing instructions.
modes.example: a single dose of montelukast sodium should be taken at least 2 hours<< before>> exercise.
